lead: Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, Monkey Beach, then lunch on Phi Phi Don and an afternoon on Bamboo Island. By join-in speedboat.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel between 08:00 and 09:00, light breakfast at Lanta Old Town pier.
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach and a snorkelling stop.
Lunch buffet on Phi Phi Don and time on the beach, then Bamboo Island: swimming and snorkelling from the beach.
The boat leaves Bamboo Island for a snorkelling stop at Loh Mudee.
Free time on Phi Phi Don until 16:00, then back to Koh Lanta and the transfer to your hotel by car or by boat.

included: Thai buffet lunch, water and fruit
Light breakfast at the pier on the join-in speedboat
Guide, English-speaking on the join-in speedboat
notIncluded: National park fee, paid in cash

beforeYouBook.pickup: Pickup at your hotel between 08:00 and 09:00, light breakfast at Lanta Old Town pier.
bring: Cash for the national park fee
beforeYouBook.weather: Maya Bay has its own rules set by the national park. The stop depends on the day and the season.

faq.q: How far is Phi Phi from Koh Lanta?
faq.a: About an hour by speedboat from the pier.

faq.q: Do we stop at Maya Bay?
faq.a: Yes, in the morning, with Viking Cave, Pileh Lagoon and Monkey Beach. Access to Maya Bay follows the national park rules of the day.

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. You pay 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child in cash.

legacyText.title: Koh Phi Phi Day Trip from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel
intro: Phi Phi is north of Koh Lanta. The speedboat crosses in about an hour. The morning is spent around Phi Phi Leh, the island with Maya Bay and Pileh Lagoon. After lunch on Phi Phi Don, the afternoon goes to Bamboo Island, with snorkeling from the beach.
legacyText.cardDescription: A day trip to the Phi Phi islands, with Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach and snorkeling stops.
goodToKnow: Private speedboat option, 9:00 to 16:00, your group only.
Children from 4 to 11 pay a child rate.
Maya Bay has its own rules set by the national park. The stop depends on the day and the season.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. The national park fee is paid on the island and is not included. For a private speedboat, ask us.
legacyText.parkFee: 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child (Thai nationals 40 and 20 THB)
legacyText.caption: Phi Phi
